cells.gaps: KCB Group and Equity Bank are connected to PAPSS (November 2026, KEN-007), but no source found says Kenyan banks or payment providers send and receive payments through it; connection or joining does not count.
cells.note: The CBK licenses payment service providers (41 in its November 2025 directory) and regulates Kenswitch, a domestic switch connecting banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers, so stage 4. Two Kenyan banks connected to PAPSS in November 2026 report no live payments, so not 5.
